articles.title: Claude Duet
articles.summary: Anthropic has unveiled Claude Duet, a proactive AI agent powered by Opus 5.5 that monitors connected apps, prioritizes tasks, and works autonomously while requesting approval before certain actions. The research preview initially targeted US Pro and Max subscribers through a waitlist.

articles.title: Introducing Flint
articles.summary: Recursive Flint is a mixture-of-experts model built for fast agentic coding on local hardware. It has 40 billion total parameters but activates just 2.5 billion per token. It was built from scratch by a small team of people and agents in under four months. Flint generates more than 125 tokens per second on an M4 Pro MacBook Pro and more than 150 tokens per second on a 64GB NVIDIA RTX Spark at short contexts. It can be used as a daily coding model to complete tasks locally without sending data to a remote server.

articles.title: OpenAI models are coming to Google Cloud
articles.summary: OpenAI's frontier models and Codex agentic workflows are coming to Google Cloud's Model Garden. The integration will give customers native access to these models to power complex agentic workflows at scale. It will pair OpenAI's frontier models with Google Cloud's built-in access controls, centralized data governance, and high-performance infrastructure to support demanding enterprise workloads. OpenAI models will soon be available in Google Antigravity and the Gemini Agent.

articles.title: If Intelligence Is Getting Cheap, What Remains Expensive?
articles.summary: Long Lake argues that acquiring established service businesses solves AI deployment barriers through customer trust, expert knowledge, proprietary data, and aligned incentives. Backed by $7.5B, the company has partnered with 40 businesses to turn automation into measurable operating gains.

articles.title: Claude Mods: Flipping the Harness Inside Out
articles.summary: Claude Mods flips the agent harness paradigm to face the human, creating a customizable "Attention Interface" for Claude AI. Mods are TypeScript or JavaScript functions that alter Claude Code's behavior in real-time, allowing users to design how Claude interacts with them. This shift lets users program the human-agent interface and even have Claude build mods, enhancing workflow and decision-making.

articles.title: How does Fable 5.1 hide messages in images?
articles.summary: Language models can encode messages in images. These messages can be decoded by the same language model even if no information about the encoding method is passed. The act of decoding the hidden messages is obvious if the tool calls of the decoding model are monitored. The encoded messaging is surprisingly hard to spot, and it could be used as a precursor to steganography in images.

articles.title: Mammoth-1 and Elephant-1: frontier decision models
articles.summary: Mammoth-1 and Elephant-1, decision models from Base Labs, top benchmarks like the Jev Decision Index and Artificial Analysis Decision Index.

articles.title: Claude API version 2026-10-21 is now available
articles.summary: The Claude API has received its first official version release since 2023. Anthropic plans to release versions more often so developers can handle breaking changes before a new model requires them. 2023-06-10 is not deprecated. New major versions of the Anthropic SDKs and CLI are out today and default to the new API. A migration guide is available.

articles.title: Announcing Humming: Fast, Flexible Kernels for Quantized Inference
articles.summary: Humming is a general-purpose kernel library for quantized inference. It features broad device support, extensive quantization support, and strong execution performance. Humming's unified architecture makes it straightforward to tune execution parameters and collect pipelines for different workloads.

articles.title: OpenAI's PHP Patcher
articles.summary: OpenAI coordinated with PHP maintainers and security partners to patch critical vulnerabilities discovered using GPT-5.6 Sol and independently by Wiz. The company also released a PHP vulnerability checker and proposed a framework for coordinating responses to AI-discovered security flaws.

articles.title: OpenClaw creator says he spent $10 million in tokens last month
articles.summary: Peter Steinberger, the creator of OpenClaw and now a member of technical staff at OpenAI, estimates that he spent around $10 million in tokens running AI workloads last month, all from out of investors' pockets. Steinberger has a virtually unlimited token budget, allowing him to work differently from others in the industry. This article collects some of his answers during a conversation with Cloudflare's CTO at the Cloudflare Connect 2026 conference.

articles.title: Contained: Oct 21, 2026 LiteLLM release v1.107.0 Compromised
articles.summary: A malicious LiteLLM package was published to PyPI and was live for approximately 2 hours before it was pulled.

articles.summary: This repository contains the official CLI for the OpenAI API.

articles.title: Monaco Launches Agent Matrix for Revenue Growth
articles.summary: Agent Matrix is a platform that coordinates multiple AI agents working continuously toward revenue growth.

articles.title: Computer use on the phone itself: a 2B model that operates Android apps
articles.summary: GUI-Owl 1.5 is a 2-billion-parameter screen model that can read an Android screen through the accessibility service and tap and type in any other app.

articles.title: A response from Dario Amodei
articles.summary: Dario Amodei responds to a post regarding Anthropic's stance on AI safety by listing the things that the company did in the past year that were pro-safety and commercially costly to it.
